prompt: The reference image shows the game's art: chunky wooden raised garden beds with crops, in cel-shaded toon 3D with dark-brown ink outlines, strict isometric view. Use exactly these beds, drawn the same way, inside the app UI. A polished mobile app screen mockup, portrait phone screen filling the whole image edge to edge, Android status bar at the top, crisp readable UI text in a friendly rounded sans-serif font, no device frame, no hands. The screen is the app's home: the title "Scroll Gate" with a small line "Your field" under it; a 2 by 2 grid of four bed cards, each showing one isometric bed with a small label under it: top left nine radishes labelled "Call mom" with a small chip "Today"; top right four lettuces labelled "Dentist" with a chip "Tomorrow 3pm"; bottom left two carrots labelled "Gym" with a chip "This week"; bottom right an empty bed of tilled soil with a "+ Plant a task" label. Under the field a small row with a blue watering can icon and "Watered today". At the bottom a text field "What do you keep putting off?" with a microphone button and a "Plant" button. Visual style: a cozy farming game. Warm cream parchment background with a faint paper grain, a carved wooden plank sign holding the title, cards framed in rounded light wood like the beds, chunky rounded buttons in leaf green with a darker bottom edge like toy blocks, warm brown text.
